scenes.text: Pericarditis. Tachycardia. Sound scary? Give me ten seconds.
I just memorise them... and forget them by Friday.
Stop memorising. Start decoding. This is MedLex.
Tap peri. Around. Card. Heart. Itis. Inflammation.
Pericarditis. The sac around the heart is inflamed. You just read it yourself.
Another one. Tachy, fast. Card, heart. Ia, a condition. Tachycardia.
Wait... I actually get it now.
